newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar maintains gains, resumes uptrend.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar maintains gains, resumes uptrend.

text.p: White sugar futures meandered in tight ranges on Friday as spread buying ensured that nearby August resumed its uptrend, market sources said.
August/October was well supported at around $6.00 as bargain-hunters viewed anything under that level as cheap, they said.
"It's come in enormously but people viewed $5.00 and $5.50 as cheap and they snapped it up," said one trader.
Most of the solid morning volume was outright, although with scattered crosses, with commission houses being the most active players.
At 1118 GMT August was up 30 cents at $324.00 and poised to test resistance at $330.80, the high seen earlier this month.
October was up 20 cents at $318.00 and volume amounted to 843 lots, mostly in August. Traders said the volume was better than it had been for some time.
But attention was centred on the open of the New York raws market after the rallies and firm closes seen on July and October. Activity on the August/July arbitrage could be brisk, they said.
"I think one or two people are sizing up this morning with a view to having a go towards the contract highs again when the raws come in, as a bit more ammunition against the specs," the trader said.
In Paris just 121 lots of August were posted on the board. The contract was up $1.20 at $324.00.
